## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are only in `skills/<skill-name>/` (and `authors/<me>.md` on a first contribution)
- [ ] `node tools/validate.mjs` passes
- [ ] `node tools/build-catalog.mjs` was run and `catalog.json` + `README.md` are committed
- [ ] Description starts with "Use this skill when" and uses the words people actually say
- [ ] Has `## What good looks like` with real judgment, and `## Rules`
- [ ] GTM verbs only, no vendor names
- [ ] Follows GLOBAL_RULES.md: human approval before sending or bulk changes, no invented facts, no data sent to third parties, no secrets
- [ ] I'm fine with MIT licensing, with attribution through my author profile
